attr.title: Real Racing 3
attr.desc: The 2013 Firemint/Firemonkeys racing game, running its original Android ARM library directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT PLAYABLE YET: the port boots, renders the front-end with readable text and reaches the driving tutorial, but no race has been reached and it has never been run on a handheld. Supply your own Real Racing 3 2.7.0 Android install and copy the extracted tree (lib/armeabi-v7a/libRealRacing3.so plus asset_list_base.txt, assets_480x320/ and the rest of the data directories) into ports/realracing3/. That tree must include the game's own fonts: the port rasterises all text from them and ships none of its own. Keep the port release named realracing3-native-arm.zip. No game data is included.
